entries.view: Digital 16-bit ambient-light sensor with I²C address 0x23 or 0x5C. VCC 2.4–3.6 V; DVI is the serial-interface reference and asynchronous reset input. Source: ROHM No.11046EDT01, Rev. D, 2011-11, terminal table p.13 and outline p.14. Component-side view follows the top outline: bottom 1–2–3 left to right, top 6–5–4 left to right. Molded body is 1.6 × 2.6 mm; total lead span is 3.0 mm. Exact package: WSOF6I. Component-side top view with all six functional leads. Underside metal details without assigned terminal numbers are not promoted to extra signal pins. Package markings are representative. The native carrier uses reference copper lands; generated 3D geometry is approximate.

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 1 — Sensor supply input, 2.4–3.6 V.

pins.label: ADDR
pins.description: 2 — Address selection: LOW gives 7-bit address 0x23, HIGH gives 0x5C; follow the source supply-sequencing requirements.

pins.label: GND
pins.description: 3 — Supply and signal ground.

pins.label: SDA
pins.description: 4 — Open-drain I²C serial data; use a pull-up to the permitted DVI reference voltage.

pins.label: DVI
pins.description: 5 — SDA/SCL reference and asynchronous reset input. Hold below 0.4 V for at least 1 µs after VCC is applied, then follow the cited supply circuit.

pins.label: SCL
pins.description: 6 — I²C serial clock input, up to 400 kHz.

entries.view: Eleven-channel spectral sensor with eight visible bands plus clear, near-IR and flicker measurement. Requires 1.8 V supply (1.7–2.0 V); I²C address 0x39. DS000504 v3-00, 2020-06-25, pin table p.6 and OLGA8 outline p.62. The bottom view shows pin 1 at the lower-right chamfered contact, 1–4 running right to left along the bottom and 5–8 left to right along the top. The optical aperture is on the hidden upper face. Exact package: OLGA8. Explicit manufacturer bottom contact view. The native footprint mirrors X to component-side coordinates; no bottom-view coordinates are silently reused as a top-view pattern. Package markings are representative. The native carrier uses reference copper lands; generated 3D geometry is approximate.

entries.view: Combined UV and ambient-light sensor with 13–20 bit conversion, I²C address 0x53, 1.7–3.6 V operating supply and a programmable interrupt. Author-original source DS86-2015-0004, mechanical outline pp.1–2 and I/O table p.4; the retained Mouser PDF mirror contains the same six-terminal function map and outline. Component-side view: bottom VDD1/NC2/GND3 left to right; top SDA6/INT5/SCL4 left to right. Exact package: 6-pin ChipLED. Component-side top view. The source bottom contact drawing is mirrored in X to match the marked top-view pin-1 corner. Package markings are representative. The native carrier uses reference copper lands; generated 3D geometry is approximate.

Component-side left column 1 SCL / 2 INT / 3 GND; right column 6 SDA / 5 VDD / 4 NC, top to bottom. Exact package: ODFN-6 (FN). Transparent optical component-side top view, following the explicit TOP VIEW pin map. The package bottom view is not used directly as a native top-view pattern. Package markings are representative. entries.view: Time-of-Flight laser ranging sensor for distances up to 2 m, with I²C address 0x29, active-low shutdown and open-drain interrupt. Supply 2.6–3.5 V; follow the selected I/O-voltage mode. This is the current C ordering code with protective liner, covered by DS11555 Rev.6. Manufacturer bottom view, p.4 and drawing p.25: right column 1–5 bottom to top, top-center 6, left column 7–11 top to bottom and bottom-center 12. The two optical apertures are on the hidden top face. Exact package: Optical LGA12 with liner. Explicit bottom contact view from the manufacturer. The native component-side carrier mirrors X relative to this drawing. The top-face optical apertures are hidden in this view. Package markings are representative. The native carrier uses reference copper lands; generated 3D geometry is approximate.
